lines.text_he: ״זכור את אשר עשה לך עמלק״, נצטווינו.
lines.text_en: “Remember what Amalek did to you,” we were commanded.
lines.translation_source: own translation of the Hebrew audio (Deut. 25:17 quoted). The ICJ application quotes Sky News' simultaneous interpretation of the same passage: 'you must remember what Amalek has done to you, says our Holy Bible. And we do remember'
own translation; matches the ICJ/Sky rendering 'And we do remember'

clips.context: Opening statement, 1:00-2:00 of the broadcast: the troops 'are committed to eradicating this evil from the world, for our existence and, I add, for the good of all humanity. The whole nation and its leadership embrace them... "Remember what Amalek did to you," we were commanded. We remember and we are fighting.' The cut ends at the pause after 'We remember'; the sentence continues 'and we are fighting' (omitted for time; the meaning is unchanged). Later in the same statement (3:24-3:34): 'The IDF does everything to avoid harming the uninvolved. I again call on the civilian population to evacuate to a safe zone in the south of the Strip.' The biblical passage (1 Samuel 15:3) is quoted in the ICJ application.
clips.notes: The preachers catalog's netanyahu_amalek_mee (MEE, from Sky News) has English audio that is Sky's simultaneous INTERPRETER, not Netanyahu's own voice: its English tracks the Hebrew statement line for line with the same timing ('the 73 October War', 'never again is now' 49 s after 'Amalek', exactly as in the Hebrew). This entry uses his own voice in Hebrew, with subtitles.

clips.context: Two days after the 7 October attack. The whole 20 s clip is used, nothing omitted. Gallant's office and supporters said 'human animals' referred to Hamas; HuffPost (9 Oct 2023) noted that 'it appears that Gallant was specifically referring to Hamas fighters in that comment', while the siege he announces applies to all of Gaza City. Cited by South Africa (ICJ, para 101) and by Amnesty International.
clips.notes: Laid as one continuous take; Hyde's 'MISSILES' at bar 125 falls inside Gallant's own 0.6 s pause after 'Gaza City' (nothing is cut or moved).

lines.text_en: if you like, the Gaza Nakba.

clips.context: The host asks whether the images of a million Gazans walking south with white flags are 'a Nakba, or something temporary'. After this line Dichter explains: 'Operationally there is no way to wage a war as the IDF wants to inside Gaza when the masses are between the tanks and the soldiers... It's the Gaza Nakba 2023.' Asked whether that is how it will end, he says he doesn't know; 'Gaza City sits on a third of the Strip.' Whisper writes נקבת for נכבת.
clips.notes: The lower-third gives the question he was answering.

lines.text_en: ...is to create such a huge pressure on Gaza that Gaza will become an area where people cannot live.

clips.context: Asked about a ground invasion, he calls it one option; 'the other option, and that's what I strongly think that we should do, is to create such a huge pressure on Gaza that Gaza will become an area where people cannot live. People cannot live until Hamas is destroyed, which means that Israel not only stop to supply energies, diesel, water, food... but we should prevent any other possible assistance by others.' He was a Defence Ministry adviser in the war's first weeks (ynet, 26 Oct 2023, cited by the ICJ application).
clips.notes: The cut starts at 'is to create'; the lower-third says he is proposing Israel's course.

lines.text_en: It's an entire nation out there that is responsible.

clips.context: Answering ITV's Rageh Omaar, who asked what Israel could do to alleviate the conflict's impact on 2 million civilians, 'many of whom have nothing to do with Hamas'. Herzog: 'there's a state... that has built a machine of evil right at our doorstep. It's an entire nation out there that is responsible. It's not true, this rhetoric about civilians not aware, not involved. It's absolutely not true. They could have risen up, they could have fought against that evil regime...' Later in the same press conference (10:38, media/israeli_voices/raw/herzog_presser_i24_context.mp4): 'I agree there are many, many innocent Palestinians who don't agree to this, but unfortunately in their homes there are missiles shooting at us.' The cut is the first sentence only; the rest restates it.
